reasons.c.integration: The gRPC C arm runs consumer and producer cases through the changed core.
reasons.c.unit: test_serialization.c changes, a new Header__key_bytes export reaches the bindings header, and Header_key, Headers add/remove/lookups and consumer-record headers behave differently.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The gRPC .NET arm runs consumer and producer cases through the changed core.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The smoke and consumer-compression tests consume through the changed fetch path, including compressed-record headers.
reasons.dotnet.soak: DeliveryReportTests drive the producer through the changed core.
reasons.dotnet.solution: The ABI conformance tests see the new export, and the header, consumer and producer unit and broker tests run the changed FFI and fetch path.
reasons.python.grpc: The gRPC Python arm runs consumer and producer cases through the changed core.
reasons.python.integration: Broker produce/consume tests run the changed fetch and header path.
reasons.python.performance: The consumer and producer performance tests run the changed path.
reasons.python.soak: The soak client produces and consumes through the changed core.
reasons.python.static: test_ffi_twins and test_error_payload_views read the generated bindings header, which gains a new function.
reasons.python.unit: The header, consumer, producer and null-argument tests go through the changed Header/Headers FFI and record headers.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: The verifiable consumer and producer run the changed core.
reasons.rust.chaos: Produces and consumes records through the changed fetch and header path.
reasons.rust.consumer: The fetch path now hands out lazily parsed headers sliced from the fetched data.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: Consumes records through the changed fetch path.
reasons.rust.doc: Existing doctests on headers, records, consumers and producers run the changed header representation.
reasons.rust.integration: Consumer and producer integration tests, and the multi-language ones, run the changed header and fetch code.
reasons.rust.integrity: Checks the integrity of consumed records, including headers, through the changed fetch path.
reasons.rust.lib: RecordHeader/RecordHeaders, DefaultRecord, utils, completed_fetch, fetch_collector, producer_batch and the FFI header/consumer-record modules change, with new unit tests in each.
reasons.rust.multilanguage-test-server: Translates records and headers between the core and the binding clients.
reasons.rust.performance: Measures the consumer and producer paths whose header handling changed.
reasons.rust.producer: Producer batch splitting now reuses record headers directly, and the header type changed.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: The verifiable producer and consumer run the changed core.
